pitch_summary: Introducing the HP EliteBook series, the pinnacle of portable productivity. With ultralight designs ranging from 1.33 kg to 1.88 kg, each model offers RAM upgrades to 16 GB and robust enterprise security features. Perfectly tailored for mobile professionals and designers, our EliteBook laptops provide reliability and performance without compromise. Elevate your work experience with HP.

- **Sleeves**:

  - **HP ElitePad Rugged Case**: Offers protection from bumps and drops.

- **Chargers**:

  - **HP 65W Smart Travel AC Adapter**: Portable power source for on-the-go.
  - **HP 90W Smart AC/Auto/Air Combo Adapter**: Flexible charging for work or travel.

- **Docking Stations**:
  - **HP 2012 120W Advanced Docking Station**: Maintain connectivity at a fixed station.
  - **HP 2012 230W Advanced Docking Station**: Designed for select HP Business Notebooks.
  - **HP 2012 90W Docking Station**: Ideal for enhancing laptop functionality at your desk.

Upgrade your setup with these essential accessories!

products.description: Comfortably carry your notebook and everyday accessories in the stylish and durable HP Business Top Load Case.

Carry your notebook and all the essentials you need for a day at the office or an overnight business trip with the stylish and durable HP Business 4-Wheel Roller Case, the case with the space for everything.
The HP Essential Messenger Case is a messenger style carrying case designed for HP business notebooks with up to a 43.94 diagonal centimeter (17.3") screen.
The HP Essential Backpack is a great notebook carrying solution for both students and business professionals.
Combining comfort and function, the HP Professional Backpack Case is designed to hold a laptop up to 39.62 diagonal centimeter (15.6") plus everything you need for a busy day or a week on the go.

HP Business Nylon Backpack offers a sturdy, all-purpose backpack for mobile professionals and students alike. Constructed from durable nylon, with extra padding in the back and shoulder straps. It is designed with comfort in mind. A foam padded handle also makes it easy to lift or carry. Easily transport a notebook up to 43.92 cm (17.3"), or store a mini or thin and light notebook up to 30.73 cm (12.1") inside a neoprene built-in pocket.
Sophistication. Durability. We've got you covered. Carry your HP ElitePad in an executive-style case that doubles as a stand on a desk or in any other work area.
Help protect your HP ElitePad from bumps and drops in busy, high-traffic environments.

HP includes a high quality AC adapter with each HP Business Notebook, HP Slate, HP Mini and HP Docking Station. Designed and tested to ensure optimum power support, the adapter also charges the notebook's internal battery simultaneously when connected.
Work smarter on the road and around the world with the HP Smart 65W Travel AC Adapter, a convenient and portable power source for use in mobile environments.

With the HP 90W AC/Auto/Air Combo Smart Adapter you can experience true power-charging flexibility at work, at home, and your car. Just use the "charging switch" to select the right voltage levels, and even power your notebook while on a plane.
HP offers a full line of docking stations designed exclusively for select HP Business Notebook platforms so you can maintain the connectivity and comfort of your laptop at a fixed station.
